summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated Bun payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that at `npm install` time downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip` into an OS tmpdir, chmods it +x, and uses it to execute a sibling bundled file `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with a shuffled numeric string array and hex-mangled identifiers (`WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`, `MmgoCP`, `_0x...`). The advertised purpose of the package is a Babel React preset; the shipped `index.js` is a plausible Babel-preset stub while the installer-facing behavior is downloading an alien runtime purely to execute an opaque bundled payload. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: fetching Bun (a non-Node runtime) is used to evade Node-based inspection of the payload, and the payload's contents cannot be statically vetted. The package name `@ornikar/babel-preset-react` occupies Ornikar's scope but the shipped preinstall + obfuscated Bun bundle are not present in Ornikar's public shared-configs repo, indicating scope impersonation or namespace hijack.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
